outcome_variable: median across reporting provinces of the province mean of RAIF field '1601 Mildiu: % cepas afectadas', March-September
threshold_provenance: PRE-REGISTERED round agronomic thresholds, NOT data-driven terciles. Terciles estimated on the full sample would let the class boundaries see every year's answer, including the test year's, which is a subtle form of leakage in a leave-one-year-out or strictly temporal backtest. Fixed round numbers cannot leak. The resulting split is 9 LOW / 6 MEDIUM / 5 HIGH — reported here as an OUTCOME of the choice, not as its justification.
why_median_across_provinces: The RAIF panel rotates: monitored parcels fall from 186 (2006) to 18 (2024) and no parcel spans all 20 seasons. A raw pooled mean would move with sample composition. The median across reporting provinces is robust to which provinces reported and to Huelva's systematically higher level.
caveats: 2024 rests on only 2 reporting provinces; its class is the least trustworthy.
Huelva runs systematically far above the others, so LEVELS are less trustworthy than RANKINGS.
This is Andalucia, not Veneto. Nothing here transfers to a Veneto forecast.
